flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:4311/#%24%3A%2FControlPanel then Wait until the tiddler titled '$:/ControlPanel' or 'Control Panel' is visible in the main column.
In the row of tabs at the top of that tiddler, click the tab that says 'Settings'.
If a second set of tabs appears inside the Settings tab and one of them says 'TiddlyWiki', @v16:"click that 'TiddlyWiki' tab".
Do not change any setting.
Is this true right now: "The Settings tab of the control panel is selected and a list of settings is visible below the tabs."?
If it is true, @v16:"store the word yes as 'ready'".
If it is not true, @v16:"store the word no as 'ready'".
Scroll down the main page to the very bottom of the settings list, until the last heading 'Toolbar Button Style', the line 'Choose the style for toolbar buttons:' and the small dropdown box with a down arrow right below that line are all fully visible.
Leave the dropdown closed and unchanged.
Wait 2 seconds.
Then stop.
